messages:
Maya S.: Heads-up: running entitlement rotation + retention sweep next Tue. Need to lock down SIEM-export leases and confirm KMS unwrap flows. Who owns the revocation path for exported snapshots?
Ashwin P.: I can take the revocation flow. What's the expected sweep scope?
Maya S.: All active SIEM export leases >90d or with last access >30d, plus any 'analyst' scoped leases lacking recent justification. We need a ticket template + automation to avoid manual churn.
Olivia R.: :thumbsup: Can we avoid breaking ongoing investigations? Need a safe window, escrow policy, and a fast-restore path for exceptions.
Ashwin P.: Plan sketch: 1) inventory leases, 2) notify owners, 3) auto-flag after 7d, 4) revoke + create wrapped snapshot. Note: KMS unwrap requires CMK approval for long-lived exports. @security-bot can you remind about CMK constraints?
security-bot: Reminder: CMK unwrap outside normal ops hours requires KeyOps sign-off + HSM window. See runbook: https://confluence.redwood.internal/keys/runbook (link).
Jordan C.: For SIEM exports we also need to rotate consumer tokens and signing keys when revoking. Do we want immediate key rotation or timeboxed overlap?
Ashwin P.: Staged rotate: new signing key for new exports, keep old key for 48h for inflight ingestion. I'll update the rollout script for staged rotation.
Maya S.: Also important: audit logs must capture who requested revocation, KMS unwrap events, and the ticket ID. Can we add ticket_id to export metadata/manifest?
Olivia R.: Yes — add ticket_id + justification to manifest. Also proposing retention defaults: PII anonymize and delete raw logs after 180d unless flagged for legal hold or active IR.
Ashwin P.: Quick ticket template I can use for automation:
```text
Summary: SIEM export lease expiry - <tenant>
Owner: <owner>
Lease id: <lease-id>
Last access: <iso-timestamp>
Reason: retention sweep
Action: revoke after 7d unless approved
Ticket: <TICKET-ID>
```
Jordan C.: Can SRE run a dry-run to preview candidates and surface any production dependencies? I'd like the CSV before we notify owners.
Maya S.: Yes — dry-run Friday. Ashwin, can you post the candidate CSV and counts? Olivia, can you own legal-hold exceptions and EU data checks?
Olivia R.: I will. I'll publish an exception form and coordinate with compliance for cross-border data.
security-bot: Dry-run scheduled: 1733380000. Notifications queued for #incidents and #legal.
Ashwin P.: One more technical note: ephemeral KMS unwrap tokens must be JIT-limited to a narrow ops window and logged. I'll add a conditional TTL enforcement in the KMS proxy and include a gate in the revoke script.
Maya S.: :thumbsup: Next steps: Ashwin posts CSV by Thu EOD, Olivia publishes exception form, Jordan books dry-run with SRE. Tag me if you hit blockers.
